name: Fist of the Dragon
body:
You have learned to harness the power inside to deliver powerful unarmed strikes.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +6 or higher.

Benefit: If you successfully strike your opponent with an unarmed strike, roll two dice, taking the better result.
